mapper.update: UPDATE facts t SET invalidated_at = now() WHERE t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.layer = 'typed' AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND t.valid_from IS NOT NULL AND t.valid_to = t.valid_from AND (t.from_statement_id IS NOT NULL OR t.implied) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types r WHERE r.id = t.predicate_id AND r.temporal = 'state') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facts s WHERE s.valid_from = t.valid_from AND s.valid_to = t.valid_from AND (s.id IN (SELECT ts.statement_id FROM typed_fact_sources ts WHERE ts.fact_id = t.id) OR s.id IN (SELECT i.statement_id FROM implied_fact_sources i WHERE i.fact_id = t.id)))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM typed_fact_sources src USING facts t WHERE src.fact_id = t.id AND t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM facts s JOIN entities se ON se.id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities oe ON oe.id = s.object_id JOIN phrase_bindings b ON b.kb_id = s.kb_id AND b.phrase = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(s.phrase,'\s+',' ','g'))) AND b.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM se.type_id AND b.object_is_value = (s.object_id IS NULL) AND (s.object_id IS NULL OR b.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM oe.type_id) WHERE s.id = src.statement_id AND s.invalidated_at IS NULL AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND b.status = 'bound' AND b.relation_type_id = t.predicate_id AND ((b.direction = 'forward' AND t.subject_id = s.subject_id) OR (b.direction = 'reverse' AND t.subject_id = s.object_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statement_qualifiers q WHERE q.fact_id = s.id AND q.role = 'mood') AND NOT (s.valid_from IS NOT NULL AND s.valid_to IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.valid_from AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = b.relation_type_id AND rt.temporal = 'state') AND b.marks IS DISTINCT FROM 'start' AND b.marks IS DISTINCT FROM 'end'))

DELETE FROM implied_fact_sources i USING implication_rules r WHERE i.rule_id = r.id AND r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (r.status <> 'approved' OR (i.statement_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM facts s JOIN entities se ON se.id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities oe ON oe.id = s.object_id WHERE s.id = i.statement_id AND s.layer = 'open' AND s.invalidated_at IS NULL AND r.trigger = 'phrase' AND r.phrase = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(s.phrase,'\s+',' ','g'))) AND r.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM se.type_id AND r.object_is_value = (s.object_id IS NULL) AND (s.object_id IS NULL OR r.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM oe.type_id))) OR (i.entity_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entities e WHERE e.id = i.entity_id AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND r.trigger = 'kind_word' AND lower(btrim(regexp_replace(e.specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) = r.phrase)))
mapper.update: UPDATE facts t SET invalidated_at = now() WHERE t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.layer = 'typed' AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (t.from_statement_id IS NOT NULL OR t.implied) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources src WHERE src.fact_id = t.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM implied_fact_sources i WHERE i.fact_id = t.id)
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id AS statement, b.relation_type_id AS property, b.direction, s.subject_id, s.object_id, s.object_value, s.valid_from, s.valid_from_precision, s.valid_from_grade, s.valid_to, s.valid_to_precision, s.attested_from, s.confidence, b.marks, (SELECT rt.temporal FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = b.relation_type_id) AS temporal FROM facts s JOIN entities se ON se.id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities oe ON oe.id = s.object_id JOIN phrase_bindings b ON b.kb_id = s.kb_id AND b.phrase = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(s.phrase,'\s+',' ','g'))) AND b.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM se.type_id AND b.object_is_value = (s.object_id IS NULL) AND (s.object_id IS NULL OR b.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM oe.type_id) WHERE s.kb_id = #{kbId} AND s.layer = 'open' AND s.invalidated_at IS NULL AND b.status = 'bound' AND (b.direction = 'forward' OR s.object_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (s.valid_from IS NOT NULL AND s.valid_to IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.valid_from AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = b.relation_type_id AND rt.temporal = 'state') AND b.marks IS DISTINCT FROM 'start' AND b.marks IS DISTINCT FROM 'end') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statement_qualifiers q WHERE q.fact_id = s.id AND q.role = 'mood')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM errata_actions ea WHERE ea.statement_id = s.id AND ea.predicate_id = b.relation_type_id AND ea.status = 'applied' AND ea.action IN ('retract', 'revise')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources src JOIN facts t ON t.id = src.fact_id WHERE src.statement_id = s.id AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND t.predicate_id = b.relation_type_id) ORDER BY s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET from_statement_id = #{statementId} WHERE id = #{factId} AND from_statement_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fact_evidence (fact_id, chunk_id, quote, document_id, doc_version, proposed_predicate, quote_start, quote_end) SELECT #{factId}, chunk_id, quote, document_id, doc_version, proposed_predicate, quote_start, quote_end FROM fact_evidence WHERE fact_id = #{statementId} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO typed_fact_sources (fact_id, statement_id) SELECT #{factId}, src.statement_id FROM facts n JOIN typed_fact_sources src ON src.fact_id = n.supersedes WHERE n.id = #{factId} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM typed_fact_sources src USING facts n WHERE n.id = #{factId} AND src.fact_id = n.supersedes
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO typed_fact_sources (fact_id, statement_id) VALUES (#{factId}, #{statementId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS rule, s.id AS statement, NULL::uuid AS entity, s.subject_id, r.conclude_property_id AS property, CASE WHEN r.reading IS NULL THEN s.object_id ELSE pr.entity_id END AS object_id, CASE WHEN r.reading IS NULL THEN s.object_value ELSE pr.value END AS object_value, s.valid_from, s.valid_from_precision, s.valid_from_grade, s.valid_to, s.valid_to_precision, s.attested_from, s.confidence FROM implication_rules r JOIN facts s ON s.kb_id = r.kb_id AND s.layer = 'open' AND s.invalidated_at IS NULL JOIN entities se ON se.id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities oe ON oe.id = s.object_id LEFT JOIN phrase_readings pr ON r.reading IS NOT NULL AND pr.kb_id = r.kb_id AND pr.reading = r.reading AND pr.phrase = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(oe.canonical_name, s.object_value ->> 'value', s.object_value #>> '{}', ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.status = 'approved' AND r.trigger = 'phrase' AND r.phrase = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(s.phrase, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) AND r.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM se.type_id AND r.object_is_value = (s.object_id IS NULL) AND (s.object_id IS NULL OR r.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM oe.type_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statement_qualifiers q WHERE q.fact_id = s.id AND q.role = 'mood') AND (r.reading IS NULL OR pr.entity_id IS NOT NULL OR pr.value IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (s.valid_from IS NOT NULL AND s.valid_to IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.valid_from AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = r.conclude_property_id AND rt.temporal = 'state')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM errata_actions ea WHERE ea.statement_id = s.id AND ea.predicate_id = r.conclude_property_id AND ea.status = 'applied' AND ea.action IN ('retract', 'revise')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM implied_fact_sources i JOIN facts t ON t.id = i.fact_id WHERE i.rule_id = r.id AND i.statement_id = s.id AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL) ORDER BY s.id

SELECT r.id AS rule, NULL::uuid AS statement, e.id AS entity, e.id AS subject_id, r.conclude_property_id AS property, pr.entity_id AS object_id, pr.value AS object_value, NULL::timestamptz AS valid_from, NULL::text AS valid_from_precision, NULL::text AS valid_from_grade, NULL::timestamptz AS valid_to, NULL::text AS valid_to_precision, NULL::timestamptz AS attested_from, 0.9::real AS confidence FROM implication_rules r JOIN entities e ON e.kb_id = r.kb_id AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND lower(btrim(regexp_replace(e.specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) = r.phrase JOIN phrase_readings pr ON pr.kb_id = r.kb_id AND pr.reading = r.reading AND pr.phrase = r.phrase WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.status = 'approved' AND r.trigger = 'kind_word' AND r.reading IS NOT NULL AND (pr.entity_id IS NOT NULL OR pr.value IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM implied_fact_sources i JOIN facts t ON t.id = i.fact_id WHERE i.rule_id = r.id AND i.entity_id = e.id AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL) ORDER BY e.id
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET implied = TRUE WHERE id = #{factId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO implied_fact_sources (fact_id, rule_id, statement_id, entity_id) VALUES (#{factId}, #{ruleId}, #{statementId}, #{entityId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

UPDATE facts t SET attested_from = src.at, attested_by = src.by FROM (SELECT u.fact_id, min(s.attested_from) AS at, (array_agg(s.attested_by ORDER BY s.attested_from NULLS LAST, s.id))[1] AS by FROM (SELECT ts.fact_id, ts.statement_id FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN facts k ON k.id = ts.statement_id AND k.kb_id = #{kbId} UNION ALL
SELECT i.fact_id, i.statement_id FROM implied_fact_sources i JOIN implication_rules r ON r.id = i.rule_id AND r.kb_id = #{kbId}) u LEFT JOIN facts s ON s.id = u.statement_id AND s.invalidated_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.fact_id) src WHERE t.id = src.fact_id AND t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.layer = 'typed' AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (#{only,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[] IS NULL OR t.id = ANY(#{only,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[])) AND (t.implied OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts WHERE ts.fact_id = t.id)) AND (t.attested_from IS DISTINCT FROM src.at OR t.attested_by IS DISTINCT FROM src.by) RETURNING t.id
SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND layer = 'typed' AND from_statement_id IS NOT NULL AND invalidated_at IS NULL
